letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Since our wedding on the 23rd of February, you’ve turned ordinary moments into magical memories—your laugh, your gentle touch, your endless optimism. I love how you’re my cutie who makes every corner of our world glow. No matter where we are, my heart beats only for you, and I can’t wait for the next adventure together.
poem:
In desert dunes or city rain,  
Your smile erases every pain.  
Across the miles, our love’s a tune,  
Together, forever—under sun and moon.
